name: Project Knowledge Pipeline
description: Built-in project-scoped pipeline for raw snapshot ingestion, NLP enrichment (tokenize / POS / syntax / SRL), and agentic quality review.

steps.name: Raw Snapshot
steps.description: Create a versioned snapshot of each source file into .knowledge/raw, recording file hash, mtime, and byte size.
steps.prompt: Snapshot source files into .knowledge/raw; emit snapshot-manifest.json with file count, byte totals, and per-file hashes.

steps.name: Build Chunks
steps.description: Split raw snapshots into semantic chunks (paragraphs / sections) and write chunk payloads to .knowledge/chunks.
steps.prompt: Split each snapshot into content chunks; emit chunk-manifest.json with chunk ids, byte ranges, and source refs.

steps.name: Build Interlinear
steps.description: Normalise each raw snapshot into sentence-per-line interlinear text files (.knowledge/interlinear) for downstream NLP stages.
steps.prompt: Produce interlinear sentence files from raw snapshots; emit interlinear-manifest.json with line counts and char statistics.

steps.name: Tokenize
steps.description: Run word segmentation on interlinear files and write token sequences to .knowledge/tokenize.
steps.prompt: Tokenize each interlinear file; emit tokenize-manifest.json with token counts, OOV rates, and per-file totals.

steps.name: POS Tagging
steps.description: Assign part-of-speech tags to each token using tokenize output; write POS sequences to .knowledge/pos.
steps.prompt: Tag each token with its POS label (CTB tagset); emit pos-manifest.json with tag type counts and coverage ratio.

steps.name: Syntax Parse
steps.description: Build dependency parse trees from tokenize output and write syntax artifacts to .knowledge/syntax.
steps.prompt: Parse syntax dependencies for each sentence; emit syntax-manifest.json with sentence count, token count, and relation count.

steps.name: Semantic Role Labeling
steps.description: Identify predicates and annotate semantic role arguments from tokenize output; write SRL artifacts to .knowledge/srl.
steps.prompt: Label semantic roles for each predicate span; emit srl-manifest.json with predicate count, argument count, and coverage.
